title: HUD layout (mic + meter + status + buttons)
description:
Bead 02 — HUD layout (mic + meter + status + buttons)

Goal
- Pixel-stable layout that matches the picture.

Deliverables
- Left mic button (icon)
- Center: status label
- Meter widget (fake animated)
- Right: minimize + close buttons

Definition of Done
- Clicking mic toggles Idle <-> Listening (mock state)
- Fake meter animates only when `Listening`

## Acceptance Criteria
- Clicking mic toggles Idle <-> Listening (mock state)
- Fake meter animates only when `Listening`
acceptance_criteria:
1. Clicking mic toggles `Idle` <-> `Listening` (mock state).
2. Fake meter animates only when in `Listening`.

title: Bootstrap workspace
description:
Bead 00 — Bootstrap workspace

Goal
- Repo compiles and shows an empty window.

Deliverables
- `Cargo.toml` with deps: `gtk4`, `libadwaita` (`adw`), `glib`
- `src/main.rs` minimal app window
- `README.md` with build/run

Commands
- `cargo run`

Definition of Done
- A window opens and app exits cleanly

## Acceptance Criteria
- A window opens and app exits cleanly
acceptance_criteria:
1. A window opens successfully.
2. App exits cleanly.

title: GStreamer: record WAV to temp file
description:
Bead 06 — GStreamer: record WAV to temp file

Goal
- While listening, record to WAV.

Pipeline
- `pipewiresrc ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! wavenc ! filesink location=...`

Deliverables
- `audio/record.rs`:
  - `start(wav_path, on_level)`
  - `stop() -> wav_path`

Definition of Done
- WAV file exists and plays back
- Meter still updates during recording (either via `tee` or separate pipeline)

## Acceptance Criteria
- WAV file exists and plays back
- Meter still updates during recording (either via `tee` or separate pipeline)
acceptance_criteria:
1. WAV file exists after recording and plays back successfully.
2. Meter continues updating during recording (via `tee` or a separate pipeline).

title: ASR subprocess (whisper-cli)
description:
Bead 08 — ASR subprocess (whisper-cli)

Goal
- Run whisper.cpp transcription and capture text.

Deliverables
- `asr.rs`:
  - `transcribe(wav_path, model_path, args) -> Result<String>`
- Runs on background thread; UI stays responsive
- Captures stdout and error output

Definition of Done
- With `ASR_MODEL=...` or `--model`, you get transcription text

## Acceptance Criteria
- With `ASR_MODEL=...` or `--model`, you get transcription text
acceptance_criteria: 1. With `ASR_MODEL=...` or `--model`, transcription text is returned successfully.

title: Styling (rounded corners + shadow + gloss)
description:
Bead 03 — Styling (rounded corners + shadow + “gloss”)

Goal
- Make it look like a “floating control”.

Deliverables
- CSS file under `assets/style.css`
- Rounded container, subtle shadow
- Hover/active styles for buttons
- “Listening” highlighted state (accent glow)

Definition of Done
- Visually resembles a HUD (rounded, shadowed, compact)

## Acceptance Criteria
- Visually resembles a HUD (rounded, shadowed, compact)
acceptance_criteria: 1. UI visually resembles a HUD (rounded, shadowed, compact).

title: GStreamer: live mic level meter
description:
Bead 05 — GStreamer: live mic level meter

Goal
- Real mic level drives the meter.

Approach
- GStreamer pipeline (monitor only):
  `pipewiresrc ! audioconvert ! audioresample ! level interval=100000000 ! fakesink`
- Listen for `level` element bus messages, extract peak/RMS

Deliverables
- `audio/monitor.rs`:
  - `start(on_level: Fn(f32))`
  - `stop()`

Definition of Done
- Speaking changes meter smoothly
- Start/stop works repeatedly without crash

## Acceptance Criteria
- Speaking changes meter smoothly
- Start/stop works repeatedly without crash
acceptance_criteria:
1. Speaking changes meter smoothly in real time.
2. Start/stop can be repeated without crashes.

title: State machine (single source of truth)
description:
Bead 04 — State machine (single source of truth)

Goal
- Formal states & transitions.

States
- `Idle`
- `Listening`
- `Transcribing`
- `Error(String)`

Deliverables
- `state.rs` enum + methods
- UI updates driven only by state changes

Definition of Done
- Buttons enabled/disabled correctly per state
- No UI-only state drift

## Acceptance Criteria
- Buttons enabled/disabled correctly per state
- No UI-only state drift
acceptance_criteria:
1. Buttons are enabled/disabled correctly per state.
2. No UI-only state drift from the source-of-truth state machine.

title: HUD window behavior (borderless + always on top)
description:
Bead 01 — HUD window behavior (borderless + always on top)

Goal
- Floating HUD behavior.

Deliverables
- Undecorated window
- Keep-above enabled
- Fixed size (e.g. `420x72`)
- Draggable anywhere (drag gesture)

Implementation notes
- `gtk::Window::set_decorated(false)`
- `gtk::Window::set_keep_above(true)`
- Drag: `gtk::GestureDrag` + `window.begin_move_drag(...)` (or manual move on motion)

Definition of Done
- Looks like a widget (no titlebar)
- Can be dragged around
- Stays above other windows

## Acceptance Criteria
- Looks like a widget (no titlebar)
- Can be dragged around
- Stays above other windows
acceptance_criteria:
1. Window looks like a widget (no titlebar).
2. Window can be dragged around.
3. Window stays above other windows.

title: Model discovery + config
description:
Bead 09 — Model discovery + config

Goal
- Don’t make users hunt paths.

Deliverables
- Search order:
  - CLI `--model`
  - env `ASR_MODEL`
  - `~/.cache/asr-hud/models/`
  - `/usr/share/asr-hud/models/` (optional)
- `scripts/fetch-model.sh` downloads a default model to cache

Definition of Done
- If model missing: friendly error with exact fix command

## Acceptance Criteria
- If model missing: friendly error with exact fix command
acceptance_criteria:
1. If model is missing, the app shows a friendly error.
2. The error includes the exact fix command to resolve it.

title: Wire Listen button to recording
description:
Bead 07 — Wire Listen button to recording

Goal
- Mic button actually records.

Deliverables
- `Idle` -> `Listening` starts recording + meter
- `Listening` -> `Transcribing` stops recording and hands WAV path forward

Definition of Done
- WAV is created and finalized on stop
- UI shows `Listening`/`Transcribing` states

## Acceptance Criteria
- WAV is created and finalized on stop
- UI shows `Listening`/`Transcribing` states
acceptance_criteria:
1. WAV is created when listening starts and finalized on stop.
2. UI shows `Listening` and `Transcribing` states at the correct times.
